address: 612 North Orange Ave Suite A14, Jupiter, FL 33458

hero.sub: Every light in the house from a keypad, your phone, or your voice. Scenes for the evening, schedules while you travel, and a lit entry when you get home.

items.p: One engraved button sets the room: bright, entertain, movie, off. No wall of switches.
Lights follow your schedule and the sun. The house looks lived in while you are away.
Ask for a scene from the couch, or tap it on your phone from anywhere in the world.

about.h2: Electrical and home automation from one company
about.p: Teel Electric Company is an electrical and home automation contractor serving South Florida from Jupiter. We are a Lutron dealer and installer, and our licensed electricians take a home from the first estimate to the finished lighting system.

items.p: I have used Teel Electric multiple times on a variety of projects. They’ve installed everything from fans to generators. I’ve hired them to do complete Commerical remodels and repairs on existing buildings.
A representative from Teel Electric came to our home in NC after Hurricane Florence blow a tree onto our house. They were very personal and efficient.

This company really knows what they are doing. David came to our house and installed the Lutron radio RA2 system. He was very professional and helpful in answering all my questions. He went above and beyond what he needed to do.

steps.p: We walk the plans with you and settle what each room needs: fixtures, keypads, shades, and how they are controlled.
Loads, keypad locations, and the wire schedule on paper before the walls close.
Our licensed electricians pull the wire, set the panels, and program every scene.
After the walkthrough we stay on the job: scene changes, new rooms, and support once the home is lived in.

items.a: One system runs every light in the house from keypads, an app, and schedules, in place of a wall of switches.

items.q: Can it go into a home that is already built?
items.a: Yes. Lutron RadioRA 2 is wireless, so in most existing homes the dimmers and keypads go in without opening walls.

items.q: Does it work with shades and audio?
items.a: Yes. Lutron shades and Sonos run from the same keypads and app.

items.q: Can I control it when I am away?
items.a: Yes. The app works from anywhere with a connection, so you can check the house and set the lights from the road.

items.q: Do you do the electrical work too?
items.a: Yes. We are licensed electricians, so the wiring, the panel, and the lighting system come from one company.

items.p: Lutron HomeWorks and RadioRA 2 for the whole house.
Sonos in every room, from the same app.
Lutron shades that move with the light.

final.p: Tell us about the home and pick a time that suits you.

form.hint: A line or two is plenty: the rooms, a new build or an existing home.
